events.name: Aarhus Festival (Aarhus Festuge)
events.when: annually, starting the last Friday of August for 10 days; 2026 edition 28 August - 6 September
events.blurb: One of the largest cultural festivals in Scandinavia, filling Aarhus with music, art, theatre, gastronomy and public events across the whole city.

events.name: The Tall Ships Races Aarhus 2026
events.blurb: Aarhus serves as a host port for the international Tall Ships Races, with large sailing vessels in the harbour and four days of maritime festivities along the waterfront.

events.name: NorthSide Festival
events.when: annually in early June; 2026 edition 4-6 June
events.blurb: Major Aarhus open-air music festival held at Eskelunden, featuring Danish and international artists with a strong focus on sustainability.

events.name: Aarhus Jazz Festival
events.when: annually in late June/early July; 2026 edition approx. 26 June - 5 July
events.blurb: Annual jazz festival running since 1989, with hundreds of concerts at dozens of venues around Aarhus featuring local and international jazz artists.

events.name: Aarhus Food Festival
events.when: annually in early September; 2026 edition 4-6 September
events.blurb: Large Nordic food festival celebrating Danish and regional produce, cooking schools and food companies, held in Aarhus.

events.name: Sankt Hans Aften (Midsummer's Eve)
events.when: annually on 23 June; bonfires lit across Aarhus including the harbour and waterfront near Risskov
events.blurb: Traditional Danish Midsummer's Eve, marked with bonfires, singing and gatherings throughout Aarhus, including beachside and harbour locations near the bay.

events.name: SPOT Festival
events.when: annually in early May; 2026 edition 1-2 May
events.blurb: Showcase festival for emerging Danish and Nordic music talent, held at venues across Aarhus.

events.name: Festivity of Saint Blaise (Festa svetog Vlaha)
events.when: Early February each year, main day 3 February (preceded by the Dubrovnik Festa, 25 Jan-2 Feb)
events.blurb: Dubrovnik's biggest traditional and religious celebration, honouring the city's patron saint, held continuously since 972 AD and inscribed on the UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage list. The day features holy mass, the release of white doves, a grand procession through the Old Town with reliquaries and parish banners, and the Trombunjeri firing their muskets at Pile Gate. A short walk from Bellevue Beach.

events.name: Midsummer Scene Festival
events.when: Late June to early July each year
events.blurb: International open-air theatre festival celebrating Shakespeare and English-language drama, staged each evening under the stars at the dramatic Fort Lovrijenac above the sea. The 2026 edition runs 24 June to 5 July with a new production, 'One for All', a fresh take on The Three Musketeers. An easy trip from Bellevue Beach near the Old Town.

events.name: Dubrovnik Summer Festival (Dubrovacke ljetne igre)
events.when: Mid-July to late August each year
events.blurb: Dubrovnik's flagship cultural event, one of Croatia's most important festivals, turning the Old Town's squares, palaces and fortresses into open-air stages. The 77th edition runs 10 July to 25 August 2026 with over 70 drama, music and dance performances, including the Academy of St Martin in the Fields with Joshua Bell. Opens with the raising of the Libertas flag in front of St Blaise's Church.

events.name: Good Food Festival
events.when: October each year (autumn)
events.blurb: Dubrovnik's autumn gastronomy festival organised by the city tourist board, celebrating local Dalmatian flavours, tradition and contemporary cuisine. The 2026 edition runs 5 to 18 October with culinary events, workshops, tastings and special restaurant menus across the city. A flavourful reason to visit beyond beach season.

events.name: Dubrovnik Winter Festival
events.when: Late November to early January each year
events.blurb: Dubrovnik's advent and winter celebration filling the Old Town with festive lights, concerts, food and family programming, with more than 200 cultural and entertainment events including many for children. A lively off-season highlight in the historic centre near Bellevue Beach.

events.name: Moesgaard Viking Moot (Vikingedage)
events.when: Annually on the last weekend of July; 2026 edition 23-26 July
events.blurb: Scandinavia's largest and oldest Viking reenactment festival, held right at Moesgård Beach next to Moesgaard Museum. Features a Viking camp, market stalls, craftspeople, warriors, archery, music and sagas.

events.name: The Snow Queen at Moesgaard (open-air theatre)
events.when: 21 May - 27 June 2026, evening performances on the grounds of Moesgaard Museum
events.blurb: The Royal Danish Theatre stages Hans Christian Andersen's The Snow Queen as a spectacular outdoor performance in the landscape around Moesgaard Museum, just above the beach.

events.name: NorthSide Festival
events.when: Annually in early June at Eskelunden, Aarhus; 2026 edition 4-6 June
events.blurb: Major three-day music festival in Aarhus known for its sustainability focus, drawing large international and Danish line-ups each year.

events.name: Aarhus Festival (Aarhus Festuge)
events.when: Annually late August to early September; 2026 edition 28 August - 6 September
events.blurb: One of Northern Europe's largest cultural festivals, a 10-day citywide event in Aarhus with more than 1,000 music, art, theatre and street happenings.

events.name: Gravity Beach Festival Copenhagen
events.when: annually in July; 2026 edition on 11 July
events.blurb: One-day open-air electronic music festival held directly on Amager Strandpark beach, with a daytime-to-midnight lineup of house and techno acts including Kolsch.

events.name: Neptune Challenge
events.when: annually in June; 2026 edition 20-21 June
events.blurb: Endurance open-water swim event at Amager Strandpark inspired by backyard-ultra format, with swimmers completing 1.5 km every hour over options from 6 up to 42 hours.

events.name: Copenhagen Beach Swim
events.when: annually in early August (2025 edition was 9 August); 2026 date to be confirmed
events.blurb: Annual open-water swim festival at Amager Strandpark with race distances from 1.25 km to 5 km starting and finishing at Helgoland, combined with music and a beach party.

events.name: Copenhagen Jazz Festival
events.when: annually in early/mid July (first two weeks); 2026 edition expected early July
events.blurb: Major citywide Copenhagen jazz festival with over 1,000 concerts across more than 100 venues, within easy reach of the Amager Strandpark area.

events.name: Distortion
events.when: annually late May / early June; 2026 edition expected early June
events.blurb: Large Copenhagen street and music festival drawing over 100,000 attendees, with neighbourhood street parties and a harbour rave near the city centre close to Amager.

events.name: Bønnerup Strand Havnefest og Kræmmermarked (Harbour Festival & Flea Market)
events.when: annually in early/mid July; 2026 edition 9-12 July
events.blurb: The main annual event right at Bønnerup harbour: several festive days with live music, a large flea market, funfair, food trucks, fishing-boat sailing and a harbour show. Locals and visitors gather by the water in the fishing village of Bønnerup Strand.

events.name: Gjerrild Kram Rock Jazz (Festival & Flea Market)
events.when: annually in late June; 2026 edition 25-28 June
events.blurb: Held in Gjerrild, about 10 km from Bønnerup Strand on northern Djursland. Reportedly Denmark's only free-admission festival, with two stages and over 50 hours of live music, one of Djursland's largest flea markets, a funfair, football tournaments and family activities. On-site camping is available.

events.name: World Athletics Road Running Championships Copenhagen 2026
events.when: 19-20 September 2026; 5km and One Mile on Sat 19 Sep, half marathon on Sun 20 Sep
events.blurb: Global road-running championships staged in the streets of Copenhagen, with the One Mile course running down Østerbrogade past Trianglen and Parken in Østerbro, very close to Svanemølle Beach. Tens of thousands of mass-participation runners also take part.

events.name: Copenhagen Carnival
events.when: Annually around Whitsun (Pentecost) in late May/early June; 2026 edition 5-14 June, with the main world carnival parade and celebrations centred on Fælledparken in Østerbro
events.blurb: Denmark's largest world-music carnival, with around 120 bands, 2,000 dancers and over 100,000 spectators. Its main venue is Fælledparken in Østerbro, immediately inland from Svanemølle Beach.

events.name: Copenhagen Jazz Festival
events.when: Annually in early/mid July; 2026 edition 3-12 July
events.blurb: Europe's largest jazz festival, with around 1,000 concerts at more than 100 venues across the whole city, including many free outdoor concerts in streets, parks and squares well within reach of Østerbro.

events.name: Distortion
events.when: Annually in early June; 2026 edition 3-7 June, with daily street parties rotating through Copenhagen neighbourhoods and the Distortion Ø finale rave
events.blurb: Citywide electronic-music and club-culture street festival with free daytime street parties moving through Copenhagen districts and a weekend finale rave at Refshaleøen. Draws over 100,000 visitors.

events.name: Golden Days Festival
events.when: Annually in September, with events spread across Copenhagen including Østerbro and Frederiksberg
events.blurb: Annual history and culture festival exploring Danish heritage through lectures, exhibitions, walks and creative events at many locations around Copenhagen, including Østerbro near Svanemølle Beach.

events.name: Culture Night (Kulturnatten)
events.when: Annually on the second Friday of October; 2026 edition 9 October
events.blurb: City-wide evening when more than 250 museums, theatres, churches, parks, libraries and institutions across Copenhagen open their doors with special programmes, easily accessible from the Østerbro area.

events.name: Copenhagen Marathon
events.when: Annually in May; the route runs through several districts including Østerbro near the beach
events.blurb: Major annual city marathon whose course winds through central Copenhagen neighbourhoods including Østerbro, with spectators, music and DJs along the route.

events.name: Snogebæk Havnefest (Snogebæk Harbour Festival / Brofest)
events.when: annually in July (around week 30); one-day family harbour festival
events.blurb: A long-running summer harbour festival held among the old fishermen's huts at the historic Snogebæk harbour, about 5 km north of Dueodde. Run by local volunteers with music, food and drink, games, raffles and family entertainment.

events.name: Korpsfestival Bornholm
events.when: annually in late June; 2026 edition 20-28 June (core concerts 21-26 June)
events.blurb: Festival bringing Norwegian school marching bands (around 1,000 musicians) to perform across Bornholm, with concerts and parades in towns including nearby Snogebæk and Nexø. In 2026 the bands also join the Midsummer celebrations on 23 June.

events.name: Sankt Hans Aften (Midsummer Eve bonfire)
events.when: annually on 23 June
events.blurb: Danish Midsummer Eve celebrated on 23 June with bonfires, midsummer songs and bonfire speeches. Gatherings take place at beaches and harbours around southern Bornholm, including the Snogebæk and Nexø area near Dueodde (subject to local fire-ban rules in dry years).

events.name: Nexø Harbour Christmas Market (Julemarked)
events.when: annually on weekends in late November to December (around 25 Nov - 22 Dec)
events.blurb: Christmas market at the harbour in Nexø, about 10 km north of Dueodde, featuring Bornholm food, crafts and a festive atmosphere over several weekends before Christmas.

events.name: Ringriderfesten Aabenraa (Aabenraa Ring-Riding Festival)
events.when: annually first weekend of July; 2026: July 3-6
events.blurb: Aabenraa's largest annual city festival, a traditional Southern Jutland ring-riding (tilting-at-the-ring) event combined with a fairground, market and live music. 2026 marks its 130th anniversary.

events.name: Aabenraa Streetfood Festival (Spring)
events.when: annually late April / early May; 2026: April 29 - May 2
events.blurb: A four-day street food festival held in Nørreportparken in central Aabenraa, featuring food from around the world plus music and entertainment with free admission.

events.name: Aabenraa Streetfood Festival (Autumn)
events.when: annually early September; 2026: September 2-5
events.blurb: The autumn edition of the Aabenraa street food festival in Nørreportparken, with international food stalls, concerts and entertainment over four days, free entry.

events.name: Nakskov Vinfestival
events.when: annually early August (2026: 7-8 August)
events.blurb: Annual wine festival on Axeltorv square in central Nakskov featuring wine tasting, food and live music from Lolland and around the world.

events.name: Nakskovlobet
events.when: annually spring (2026: 3 May)
events.blurb: Annual running event organised by Vestlolland Triatlonklub in Nakskov, with 5 km, 10.5 km and half-marathon distances plus children's races.

events.name: Lolland Operafestival
events.when: annually (summer)
events.blurb: Opera festival held across Lolland since 2021, offering close-up opera concerts, some of them free of charge.

events.name: The Infinite Bridge (Den Uendelige Bro)
events.when: annually April to October
events.blurb: A circular wooden walkway sculpture installed in the surf right at Ballehage Beach, originally created for Sculpture by the Sea in 2015 and now set up each year from April through October. It draws large numbers of visitors who walk out over Aarhus Bay.

events.name: New Year's Bathing at Vinterbadeklubben Ballehage
events.when: annually around 1 January
events.blurb: Vinterbadeklubben Ballehage, one of Denmark's oldest winter bathing clubs, holds a fixed New Year's swim (Nytaarsbadning) at Ballehage Beach as part of its seasonal traditions. The club is located meters from the bay at the foot of Marselisborg Forest.

events.name: Blokhus Wind Festival
events.when: annually at Whitsun (2026: May 23-24)
events.blurb: An international kite and wind festival held on the beach (Blokhus Strand) every year at Whitsun, drawing kite enthusiasts from across Europe and the USA for free flying, large kite shows and family activities along the Blokhus-Loekken coast.

events.name: Blokhus Sand Sculpture Festival
events.when: annually late April to mid-October (2026: April 30 - October 18, theme Fantasy Art)
events.blurb: An annual festival at Skulpturparken Blokhus where some of the world's leading sand sculptors create large sand sculptures; the 2026 edition runs from late April through mid-October on the theme Fantasy Art.

events.name: Blokhus New Year's Swim (Nytaarsbadning)
events.when: annually on New Year's Day at Blokhus Strand
events.blurb: Destination Blokhus hosts an annual New Year swim at Blokhus Strand, inviting people to take a cold dip in the sea for a fresh start to the year.

events.name: Hune Marked (Sunday Market)
events.when: every Sunday during the summer season
events.blurb: A popular Sunday market held in Hune near Blokhus throughout the summer, with many stalls drawing visitors from near and far.

events.name: Blåvandshuk Musikfestival
events.when: annually in early June (2026: June 6)
events.blurb: Annual outdoor music festival held at Oksbøl Stadion, the nearest town to Børsmose Strand. The 2026 edition is scheduled for 6 June and continues the festival's tradition of featuring well-known acts.

events.name: Grenaa Gademusiker Festival (Street Music Festival)
events.when: annually in May (2026: 22 May)
events.blurb: An annual free street music festival that fills Grenaa's pedestrian streets and church square with music across 11 stages. Its 10th edition was held in 2024, drawing thousands of visitors.

events.name: Grenaa Vinfestival (Wine Festival)
events.blurb: A wine festival held on the town square (Torvet) in Grenaa where visitors can taste over 250 wines from Danish and international producers.

events.name: Æblefestival (Apple Festival), Ebeltoft
events.when: annually during the autumn (fall) school holiday in October
events.blurb: An annual apple-harvest festival held in the historic town of Ebeltoft on the Djursland peninsula, celebrating the local apple harvest during the autumn school holiday.

events.name: ABC Beach Party
events.blurb: An annual one-day open-air music festival held directly on Grenaa Beach (Grenaa Strand), organized by Radio ABC, featuring a full day of live concerts on the sand. The event has a coastal-protection dispensation to run in 2025, 2026 and 2027.

events.name: Grenaa Vinfestival
events.blurb: An annual wine festival held at Torvet (the town square) in central Grenaa, where visitors can taste more than 250 wines from Danish producers and international wine houses.

havsand.town: Havneby / Lakolk, Rømø island (Tønder Municipality), Denmark

events.name: Rømø Kite Festival (Drachenfest)
events.when: 2026-09-04 to 2026-09-06 (annually, first full weekend of September)
events.blurb: Northern Europe's largest international kite festival, held on the wide Lakolk Strand on Rømø, the same broad beach area as Havsand. Thousands of colorful kites of giant animals and imaginative shapes fill the sky over the firm sand.

events.name: Rømø Motor Festival
events.when: 2026-08-22 (annually in August)
events.blurb: A beach race tribute to the golden age of motorsport where classic cars and motorcycles built before 1947 compete on the hard-packed sand of Lakolk Strand on Rømø, one of Europe's widest beaches.

events.name: Hornbæk Havnefest
events.when: annually late July (2026: 24-26 July)
events.blurb: Hornbæk's harbour festival, running since 1881, is Helsingør Municipality's largest recurring event, with three days of music, DJs, dancing, food and family activities at Hornbæk Havn. Profits go to local youth work, and children under 15 enter free.

events.name: Hornbækløbet
events.when: annually on the Saturday of the harbour festival weekend (2026: 25 July, 09:30)
events.blurb: An annual running event organised by volunteers connected to Hornbæk Rotary Klub, held during the Hornbæk Havnefest weekend. Participants can choose a 10 km run, a 5 km run, or a family-friendly 5 km walk.

events.name: Sankt Hans Aften (Midsummer Eve)
events.when: annually on 23 June
events.blurb: Denmark's nationwide midsummer celebration on 23 June, marked along the North Zealand coast including Hornbæk with beach and harbourside bonfires, communal singing and speeches. A traditional Danish summer-eve gathering rather than a single ticketed event.

events.name: Hirtshals Fiskefestival (Fish Festival)
events.when: annually the first weekend of August
events.blurb: A three-day fish and fishing festival in the harbour town of Hirtshals, just north of Kærsgård Strand, featuring a fish market, fish auction, large local-products fish buffet, tasting stalls and live music. It draws around 10,000 visitors each year.

events.name: Musik under Trappen (Music Under the Stairs)
events.when: annually mid/late July (weeks 29-30); 2026 opens 18 July
events.blurb: A week-long free open-air music festival held on the Hirtshals harbour, organised by Hirtshals Musikforening, with around 30 concerts. The 2026 edition opens on Saturday 18 July.

events.name: Tordenskioldsdage (Days of Tordenskiold)
events.when: annually, first weekend of September
events.blurb: Scandinavia's largest historical maritime festival, held in Frederikshavn's harbour area near the beach, re-enacting the era of naval hero Peter Wessel Tordenskiold with a mock naval battle, period market, replica ships, and concerts. It draws around 30,000 visitors each year.

events.name: Blues Heaven Festival
events.when: annually in autumn (early October/November)
events.blurb: An award-winning blues and soul festival held at Arena Nord in Frederikshavn, gathering dozens of top international musicians for two days of live performances. 2026 marks a milestone edition of the long-running event.

events.name: Rock i Frederikshavn
events.when: annually in June
events.blurb: An annual open-air rock concert event staged in Frederikshavn, featuring live bands performing under open skies.

events.name: Esbjerg Festuge
events.when: annually mid-to-late June (2026: June 13-21)
events.blurb: Esbjerg's annual city festival week fills the town centre with concerts, international street theatre, a children's day, exhibitions and street parades.

events.name: Suset Festival
events.when: annually in August (2026: August 21-22)
events.blurb: A summer music festival held by the harbour in Esbjerg where visitors enjoy live music and the sunset over the water.

events.name: Esbjerg Olfestival
events.when: annually in June (2026: June 20)
events.blurb: A craft beer street festival staged in the Esbjerg city centre on Jyllandsgade during Esbjerg Festuge, running in the afternoon.

events.name: ØL LØBET (Beer Run)
events.blurb: A fun run starting from Snekkersten Havn along Strandvejen past the harbour front, Kulturværftet and Marienlyst toward Sommariva, where it transitions directly into the Helsingør Karneval festivities. Open to walkers and joggers alike.

events.name: Helsingør Karneval
events.when: 2026-05-24 (Pentecost Sunday)
events.blurb: An annual Whitsun carnival and outdoor concert party at Sommarivaparken in Helsingør, just up the coast from Snekkersten, with a large stage, beer tent and food trucks. The 2026 edition coincides with the city's 600th anniversary as a market town.

events.name: Hvaler i Øresund
events.when: Whitsun/Pentecost 2026 (22-25 May), held biennially
events.blurb: A biennial gathering and regatta of classic Danish 'whale' class wooden boats (Sæler, Marsvin, Spækhuggere, Grinder, Kaskelotter) hosted at Snekkersten Havn by Snekkersten Skotterup Sejlklub, with racing around Hven, an award night and live music.
